title: Confronting Workplace Discrimination
paragraphs: Hassan noticed that promotion decisions in his company seemed unclear. Some qualified colleagues, including several women, had questions about how their performance was being assessed.
Before making assumptions, he spoke privately with colleagues and reviewed the published promotion process. He then gathered specific examples and questions.
Hassan raised the issue through the company's formal channel. He focused on clear criteria and fair communication rather than blaming particular people.
The first response was cautious, but the company later explained its process more clearly. Hassan learned that a professional question, supported by evidence, can help improve a workplace.
